q.en: Where does the hippocampus lie within the cerebral hemisphere, and what does its Greek name (given by Arantius in 1587) mean?
q.uz: Gippokamp yarim sharning qayerida joylashgan va uning yunoncha nomi (Arantius, 1587) qanday ma'noni anglatadi?

options.en: Floor of the temporal horn of the lateral ventricle; 'seahorse'
options.uz: Yon qorincha chakka shoxining tubida; 'dengiz oti'

options.en: Roof of the frontal horn of the lateral ventricle; 'almond'
options.uz: Yon qorincha frontal shoxining tomida; 'bodom'

options.en: Lateral wall of the third ventricle; 'inner chamber'
options.uz: Uchinchi qorinchaning yon devorida; 'ichki xona'

options.en: Medial wall of the occipital horn of the lateral ventricle; 'arch'
options.uz: Yon qorincha ensa shoxining medial devorida; 'ravoq'

why.en: The hippocampus is a curved fold of three-layered archicortex inside the medial temporal lobe forming the floor of the temporal (inferior) horn of the lateral ventricle; Arantius (1587) named it 'hippocampus' (Greek for seahorse) after its shape in section.
why.uz: Gippokamp — chakka bo'lagi ichidagi egilgan 3 qavatli arxikorteks burmasi bo'lib, yon qorincha chakka (pastki) shoxining tubini hosil qiladi; Arantius (1587) uni kesimdagi shakliga qarab yunoncha 'dengiz oti' deb atagan.

q.en: What are the three gross anatomical divisions of the hippocampus from anterior to posterior?
q.uz: Gippokampning oldindan orqaga joylashgan uchta asosiy anatomik qismi qaysilar?

options.en: Head, body, and tail
options.uz: Boshi, tanasi va dumi

options.en: Rostrum, genu, and splenium
options.uz: Tumshuq, tizza va splenium

options.en: Fimbria, crus, and column
options.uz: Fimbriya, oyoq va ustun

options.en: Core, shell, and ventral pallidum
options.uz: O'zak, qobiq va ventral pallidum

why.en: The hippocampus has an expanded anterior head (bearing 2–4 paw-like digitations called pes hippocampi, just behind the amygdala), a middle body along the floor of the temporal horn, and a posterior tail curving up beneath the splenium of the corpus callosum.
why.uz: Gippokampning oldinda amigdala ortida joylashgan va yuzasida 'barmoqchalar' (pes hippocampi) bo'lgan kengaygan boshi, o'rta tanasi hamda orqada splenium ostiga ko'tariladigan dumi bor.

q.en: Which arching white-matter bundle (~1.2 million axons per side) is the main output tract of the hippocampus and projects to the mammillary bodies?
q.uz: Har tomonda ~1.2 million aksondan iborat bo'lgan, gippokampning asosiy chiqish yo'li bo'lib so'rg'ichsimon tanalarga boruvchi ravoqsimon oq modda tutami qaysi?

options.en: Fornix (bilateral arching hippocampal efferent tract)
options.uz: Fornix (gippokampning juft ravoqsimon chiqish trakti)

options.en: Stria medullaris thalami (epithalamic afferent tract)
options.uz: Stria medullaris thalami (epitalamik kirish trakti)

options.en: Stria terminalis (amygdaloid efferent arch)
options.uz: Stria terminalis (amigdalaning ravoqsimon chiqish yo'li)

options.en: Cingulum bundle (medial hemispheric association tract)
options.uz: Cingulum tutami (medial yarim shar assotsiativ trakti)

why.en: The fornix (Latin for 'arch') gathers axons from the subiculum and hippocampus as the fimbria, ascends behind the thalamus as the crus, converges under the corpus callosum as the body, and splits into columns that descend into the mammillary bodies.
why.uz: Fornix (lotincha 'ravoq') gippokamp va subikulum aksonlarini fimbriya sifatida yig'ib, talamus ortida oyoq (crus) bo'lib ko'tariladi, qadoqsimon tana ostida tanani hosil qiladi va oldinda ikki ustunga (columna) bo'linib so'rg'ichsimon tanalarga tushadi.

q.en: In what order do the four segments of the fornix run from the hippocampus to the mammillary body?
q.uz: Fornixning to'rtta qismi gippokampdan so'rg'ichsimon tanagacha qanday ketma-ketlikda davom etadi?

options.en: Fimbria → crus → body → column
options.uz: Fimbriya → oyoq → tana → ustun

options.en: Column → body → crus → fimbria
options.uz: Ustun → tana → oyoq → fimbriya

options.en: Rostrum → genu → body → splenium
options.uz: Tumshuq → tizza → tana → splenium

options.en: Alveus → column → body → fimbria
options.uz: Alveus → ustun → tana → fimbriya

why.en: Axons first form the white fringe on the hippocampus (fimbria), arch upward behind the thalamus (crus), fuse in the midline beneath the corpus callosum (body), and curve down around the foramen of Monro into the hypothalamus (column).
why.uz: Gippokamp yuzasidagi oq hoshiya — fimbriya orqaga borib talamus ortida oyoqqa (crus) aylanadi, ikki oyoq qadoqsimon tana ostida birlashib tanani (corpus) hosil qiladi va oldinda ustunlar (columna) bo'lib so'rg'ichsimon tanalarga tushadi.

q.en: What is the correct sequence of stations in the classic Papez circuit (1937) for episodic memory?
q.uz: Epizodik xotiraning klassik Papez halqasidagi (1937) bekatlar qanday ketma-ketlikda joylashgan?

options.en: Hippocampus → fornix → mammillary body → mammillothalamic tract → anterior thalamus → cingulate gyrus → parahippocampal cortex
options.uz: Gippokamp → fornix → so'rg'ichsimon tana → mamillotalamik trakt → oldingi talamus → belbog' pushtasi → parahippokampal po'stloq

options.en: Hippocampus → stria terminalis → mammillary body → stria medullaris → mediodorsal thalamus → insular cortex → entorhinal cortex
options.uz: Gippokamp → stria terminalis → so'rg'ichsimon tana → stria medullaris → mediodorsal talamus → orolcha po'stlog'i → entorinal po'stloq

options.en: Amygdala → fornix → septal nuclei → mammillothalamic tract → pulvinar thalamus → orbitofrontal cortex → parahippocampal cortex
options.uz: Amigdala → fornix → septal yadrolar → mamillotalamik trakt → pulvinar talamus → orbitofrontal po'stloq → parahippokampal po'stloq

options.en: Hippocampus → anterior commissure → mediodorsal thalamus → uncinate fasciculus → orbitofrontal cortex → nucleus accumbens → amygdala
options.uz: Gippokamp → oldingi komissura → mediodorsal talamus → ilmoqsimon tutam → orbitofrontal po'stloq → accumbens yadrosi → amigdala

why.en: James Papez (1937) traced a closed loop: hippocampal formation (subiculum) → fornix → mammillary body → mammillothalamic tract (of Vicq d'Azyr) → anterior nuclear group of the thalamus → cingulate gyrus (via the cingulum) → parahippocampal/entorhinal cortex → perforant path back to the hippocampus.
why.uz: 1937 yilda James Papez yopiq halqani tasvirlagan: gippokamp → fornix → so'rg'ichsimon tana → mamillotalamik trakt → talamusning oldingi yadrosi → belbog' pushtasi (cingulum orqali) → parahippokampal/entorinal po'stloq → va yana gippokamp.

sources.title: Papez 1937, Arch Neurol Psychiatry — A proposed mechanism of emotion

q.en: Which tract carries impulses from the mammillary body up to the anterior nuclear group of the thalamus?
q.uz: So'rg'ichsimon tanadan talamusning oldingi yadrolar guruhiga impulslarni qaysi trakt olib chiqadi?

options.en: Mammillothalamic tract
options.uz: Mamillotalamik trakt

options.en: Stria medullaris thalami
options.uz: Stria medullaris thalami

options.en: Mammillotegmental tract
options.uz: Mamillotegmental trakt

options.en: Ventral amygdalofugal tract
options.uz: Ventral amigdalofugal trakt

why.en: The mammillothalamic tract (of Vicq d'Azyr) arises from the medial and lateral mammillary nuclei and ascends through the hypothalamus and internal medullary lamina to terminate in the anterior thalamic nuclei (AV, AM, AD).
why.uz: Mamillotalamik trakt (Vicq d'Azyr tutami) so'rg'ichsimon tanadan boshlanib, gipotalamus orqali yuqoriga — talamusning oldingi yadrolar guruhiga (AV, AM, AD) ko'tariladi va Papez halqasining 4-bekatini tashkil etadi.

sources.title: Papez 1937, Arch Neurol Psychiatry — A proposed mechanism of emotion

q.en: Which almond-shaped nuclear complex lies in the anterior medial temporal lobe immediately in front of the head of the hippocampus and mediates fear conditioning and emotional salience?
q.uz: Oldingi medial chakka bo'lagida, bevosita gippokamp boshining oldida joylashgan hamda qo'rquvni o'rganish va hissiy ahamiyatlilikni boshqaruvchi bodomsimon yadrolar majmuasi qaysi?

options.en: Amygdaloid complex
options.uz: Amigdala (bodomsimon tana)

options.en: Claustrum
options.uz: Klaustrum (to'siq)

options.en: Subiculum
options.uz: Subikulum (poydevor)

options.en: Habenular complex
options.uz: Habenula (yuganak)

why.en: The amygdala sits deep to the uncus in the anterior medial temporal lobe, just anterior to the head of the hippocampus and the tip of the temporal horn. It attaches emotional significance (especially fear) to sensory stimuli.
why.uz: Amigdala (bodomsimon tana) oldingi chakka bo'lagi tubida, gippokamp boshi oldida va uncus ostida joylashgan bo'lib, tajribaga hissiy ahamiyat (avvalo qo'rquv) beradi.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience — The importance of the amygdala (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: Which five structures follow the same developmental C-shaped curve around the thalamus and insula?
q.uz: Yarim sharning embrional rivojlanishi tufayli talamus va orolcha atrofida bir xil C-shaklli egrilikni takrorlovchi beshta tuzilma qaysilar?

options.en: Lateral ventricle, caudate nucleus, fornix, stria terminalis, and hippocampus
options.uz: Yon qorincha, dumli yadro, fornix, stria terminalis va gippokamp

options.en: Third ventricle, putamen, globus pallidus, subthalamic nucleus, and red nucleus
options.uz: Uchinchi qorincha, putamen, rangpar shar, subtalamik yadro va qizil yadro

options.en: Fourth ventricle, pontine nuclei, inferior olive, dentate nucleus, and pyramid
options.uz: To'rtinchi qorincha, ko'prik yadrolari, pastki zaytun, tishsimon yadro va piramida

options.en: Cerebral aqueduct, superior colliculus, pulvinar, pineal gland, and habenula
options.uz: Silviy suv yo'li, yuqori do'nglik, pulvinar, epifiz bezi va habenula

why.en: As the telencephalic hemisphere expands forward, up, back, and then down and forward around the insula, the lateral ventricle, caudate nucleus, fornix–hippocampus, and stria terminalis (from the amygdala) are all swept into matching C-curves alongside the corpus callosum and cingulate gyrus.
why.uz: Rivojlanish davomida yarim shar orolcha atrofida oldinga, yuqoriga, orqaga va pastga-oldinga buralib o'sgani uchun yon qorincha, dumli yadro, fornix, stria terminalis va gippokamp (hamda qadoqsimon tana va belbog' pushtasi) bir xil C-egrilikni hosil qiladi.

q.en: How many cortical cell layers does the hippocampus (archicortex) have, compared with the six layers of the neocortex?
q.uz: Neokorteks 6 qavatdan iborat bo'lsa, gippokamp (arxikorteks) nechta hujayra qavatidan tashkil topgan?

options.en: Three layers (molecular, pyramidal/granule, and polymorphic)
options.uz: Uch qavat (molekulyar, piramidal/donador va polimorf)

options.en: Six layers (matching the organization of the precentral gyrus)
options.uz: Olti qavat (oldingi markaziy pushta neokorteksi bilan bir xil)

options.en: Five layers (transitional mesocortex lacking an internal granular layer)
options.uz: Besh qavat (ichki donador qavatsiz o'tuvchi mezokorteks)

options.en: Four layers (agranular paleocortex found in the piriform lobe)
options.uz: To'rt qavat (noksimon bo'lakdagi agranulyar paleokorteks)

why.en: The hippocampal formation (cornu Ammonis and dentate gyrus) is phylogenetically ancient archicortex with three fundamental layers, unlike the six-layered mammalian neocortex.
why.uz: Gippokamp (Ammon shoxi va tishsimon pushta) filogenetik qadimgi arxikorteks bo'lib, olti qavatli neokorteksdan farqli ravishda uchta asosiy qavatdan iborat.

q.en: Which gyrus on the medial surface of the temporal lobe wraps around the hippocampus and contains the entorhinal cortex — the main gateway to the hippocampus?
q.uz: Chakka bo'lagining medial yuzasida gippokampni o'rab turgan va o'z ichiga gippokampning asosiy darvozasi — entorinal po'stloqni olgan pushta qaysi?

options.en: Parahippocampal gyrus
options.uz: Parahippokampal pushta

options.en: Fusiform gyrus
options.uz: Urchuqsimon pushta

options.en: Inferior temporal gyrus
options.uz: Pastki chakka pushtasi

options.en: Superior temporal gyrus
options.uz: Yuqori chakka pushtasi

why.en: The parahippocampal gyrus lies on the ventromedial temporal lobe adjacent to the hippocampus; its anterior end hooks back as the uncus, and its anterior cortex is the entorhinal area (BA28), which funnels cortical input into the hippocampus.
why.uz: Parahippokampal (gippokamp yoni) pushta medial chakka bo'lagida gippokampni o'rab yotadi; oldingi uchi ilmoq (uncus) bo'lib qayrilgan, po'stlog'ida esa neokorteks bilan gippokamp orasidagi darvoza — entorinal maydon (BA28) joylashgan.

q.en: What is the unidirectional sequence of stations and fibre pathways in the internal trisynaptic circuit of the hippocampal formation?
q.uz: Gippokamp ichidagi bir yo'nalishli trisinaptik zanjirda tuzilmalar va tola yo'llari qanday ketma-ketlikda joylashgan?

options.en: Entorhinal cortex → perforant path → dentate gyrus → mossy fibres → CA3 → Schaffer collaterals → CA1 → subiculum
options.uz: Entorinal po'stloq → perforant yo'l → tishsimon pushta → moxsimon tolalar → CA3 → Schaffer kollaterallari → CA1 → subikulum

options.en: Subiculum → Schaffer collaterals → CA1 → perforant path → CA3 → mossy fibres → dentate gyrus → entorhinal cortex
options.uz: Subikulum → Schaffer kollaterallari → CA1 → perforant yo'l → CA3 → moxsimon tolalar → tishsimon pushta → entorinal po'stloq

options.en: Entorhinal cortex → mossy fibres → CA1 → perforant path → dentate gyrus → Schaffer collaterals → CA3 → subiculum
options.uz: Entorinal po'stloq → moxsimon tolalar → CA1 → perforant yo'l → tishsimon pushta → Schaffer kollaterallari → CA3 → subikulum

options.en: Dentate gyrus → perforant path → entorhinal cortex → Schaffer collaterals → CA3 → mossy fibres → CA1 → subiculum
options.uz: Tishsimon pushta → perforant yo'l → entorinal po'stloq → Schaffer kollaterallari → CA3 → moxsimon tolalar → CA1 → subikulum

why.en: Signals enter from the entorhinal cortex via the perforant path to granule cells of the dentate gyrus (synapse 1), travel via mossy fibres to CA3 pyramidal cells (synapse 2), and pass via Schaffer collaterals to CA1 pyramidal cells (synapse 3), which project to the subiculum and back out via the entorhinal cortex or fornix.
why.uz: Trisinaptik zanjir: entorinal po'stloqdan perforant yo'l orqali tishsimon pushtaga (DG), undan moxsimon tolalar orqali CA3 ga, CA3 dan Schaffer kollaterallari orqali CA1 ga va undan subikulum orqali qayta entorinal po'stloq hamda fornixga yo'naladi (E-T-3-1-S).

q.en: Which subfield of the hippocampus (known as Sommer's sector) is the most selectively vulnerable to global hypoxia/ischaemia (such as cardiac arrest) and shows punctate DWI lesions in transient global amnesia?
q.uz: Gippokampning qaysi submaydoni ('Sommer sektori') gipoksiya va ishemiyaga (masalan, yurak to'xtashiga) eng sezgir bo'lib, tranzitor global amneziyada DWI MRTda nuqtali o'choqlar ko'rsatadi?

options.en: CA1 (cornu Ammonis sector 1)
options.uz: CA1 (Ammon shoxining 1-sektori)

options.en: CA2 (cornu Ammonis sector 2)
options.uz: CA2 (Ammon shoxining 2-sektori)

options.en: Dentate gyrus granule cell layer
options.uz: Tishsimon pushtaning donador qavati

options.en: Subiculum pyramidal cell layer
options.uz: Subikulumning piramidal qavati

why.en: CA1 (Sommer's sector) pyramidal neurons are exquisitely sensitive to glutamate excitotoxicity and hypoxia, dying selectively after cardiac arrest or in hippocampal sclerosis, and showing punctate lateral hippocampal DWI hyperintensities 24–48 h after transient global amnesia.
why.uz: CA1 (Sommer sektori) piramidal neyronlari glutamat eksaytotoksikligi va gipoksiyaga eng sezgir bo'lib, yurak to'xtashidan keyin va gippokampal sklerozda birinchi nobud bo'ladi; tranzitor global amneziyada ham aynan CA1 da nuqtali DWI o'choqlar ko'rinadi.

q.en: Where does neurofibrillary tau tangle pathology begin earliest (Braak stages I–II) in Alzheimer disease, even before spreading to the hippocampus proper?
q.uz: Altsgeymer kasalligida neyrofibrillyar tau-chigallar patologiyasi gippokampning o'zidan ham oldin, eng erta (Braak I–II bosqichlari) qaysi po'stloq sohasida boshlanadi?

options.en: Transentorhinal and entorhinal cortex (BA28)
options.uz: Transentorinal va entorinal po'stloqda (BA28)

options.en: Posterior cingulate and retrosplenial cortex
options.uz: Orqa belbog' va retrosplenial po'stloqda

options.en: Anterior orbitofrontal and insular cortex
options.uz: Oldingi orbitofrontal va orolcha po'stlog'ida

options.en: Primary visual and calcarine cortex (V1)
options.uz: Birlamchi ko'rish va kalkarin po'stlog'ida

why.en: In Braak staging of Alzheimer disease, neurofibrillary tangles appear first in the transentorhinal and entorhinal cortex on the anterior parahippocampal gyrus (stages I–II), then invade the subiculum and CA1 of the hippocampus (stages III–IV), and finally spread to the neocortex (stages V–VI).
why.uz: Altsgeymer kasalligida tau patologiyasi eng avval (Braak I–II) oldingi parahippokampal pushtadagi transentorinal va entorinal po'stloqda boshlanadi, so'ngra subikulum va gippokampning CA1 sektoriga (III–IV) o'tadi. Gippokamp hajmi Altsgeymerda yiliga 3–5 % ga (normal qarishda ~1 %) kichrayadi.

q.en: How do the precommissural and postcommissural fibres of the columns of the fornix divide around the anterior commissure, and where does each component terminate?
q.uz: Fornix ustunlari oldingi komissura atrofida komissuradan oldingi (prekommissural) va keyingi (postkommissural) tolalarga qanday ajraladi va ular qayerga boradi?

options.en: Postcommissural passes behind to mammillary bodies; precommissural passes in front to septal nuclei and nucleus accumbens
options.uz: Postkommissural qism ortidan so'rg'ichsimon tanalarga; prekommissural qism oldidan septal yadrolar va accumbensga boradi

options.en: Postcommissural passes in front to septal nuclei; precommissural passes behind to mammillary bodies and anterior thalamus
options.uz: Postkommissural qism oldidan septal yadrolarga; prekommissural qism ortidan so'rg'ichsimon tanalar va talamusga boradi

options.en: Postcommissural descends to the habenular nuclei; precommissural curves laterally into the basolateral amygdala and insula
options.uz: Postkommissural qism habenular yadrolarga tushadi; prekommissural qism lateralga bazolateral amigdala va orolchaga boradi

options.en: Both bundles pass behind the anterior commissure, then split to innervate the mediodorsal thalamus and hypothalamus
options.uz: Ikkala tutam ham oldingi komissura ortidan o'tib, so'ngra mediodorsal talamus va gipotalamusga ajralib tugaydi

why.en: At the anterior commissure, the fornix splits: the larger postcommissural column descends behind the commissure through the hypothalamus (dividing it into medial and lateral zones) to the mammillary body; the smaller precommissural bundle passes in front of the commissure to the septal nuclei and ventral striatum (nucleus accumbens).
why.uz: Oldingi komissura darajasida fornix ustuni ikkiga bo'linadi: asosiy postkommissural qism komissura ortidan gipotalamus orqali (uni medial va lateral zonalarga ajratib) so'rg'ichsimon tanalarga tushadi; prekommissural tolalar esa komissura oldidan septal yadrolar va accumbens yadrosiga boradi.

q.en: Why does a coronal brain section through the mid-thalamus or pallidum (plate B3 or B4) show the caudate nucleus cut in TWO separate places in each hemisphere?
q.uz: Nima sababdan o'rta talamus yoki pallidum orqali o'tgan bitta koronal kesimda (B3 yoki B4 plastinkasida) dumli yadro (kaudat) har yarim sharda IKKI marta kesilgan holda ko'rinadi?

options.en: The C-shaped caudate is cut dorsally through its body and ventrolaterally through its tail
options.uz: C-shaklli kaudat yuqorida tanasi va pastki-lateralda dumi orqali ikki marta kesiladi

options.en: The internal capsule splits a single straight caudate into separate medial and lateral halves
options.uz: Ichki kapsula bitta to'g'ri kaudatni alohida medial va lateral bo'laklarga ajratib qo'yadi

options.en: The caudate branches anteriorly into a dorsal thalamic limb and a ventral amygdaloid limb
options.uz: Kaudat oldinda dorsal talamik va ventral amigdaloid shoxlarga ayrilib davom etadi

options.en: The striatal cell bridges detach the ventral caudate head from the dorsal caudate body
options.uz: Striatal hujayra ko'prikchalari kaudat boshini yuqori kaudat tanasidan ajratib turadi

why.en: Because the caudate nucleus arches in a full C around the thalamus and lentiform nucleus, a single coronal plane behind the interventricular foramen intersects the caudate body superiorly (in the lateral wall of the ventricular body) and the caudate tail inferiorly (in the roof of the temporal horn above the amygdala/hippocampus).
why.uz: Dumli yadro yon qorincha bilan birga to'liq C shaklida buralgani uchun bitta koronal kesim uni ikki joyda kesib o'tadi: tepada (qorincha tanasi yonida) kaudatning boshi/tanasi va pastda (chakka shoxi tomida) kaudatning ingichka dumi ko'rinadi.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience 2nd ed. — Modulation of movement by the basal ganglia (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: In the Julich-Brain cytoarchitectonic atlas of the amygdala, what are the distinct roles of the laterobasal (LB), centromedial (CM), and superficial (SF) nuclear groups?
q.uz: Julich-Brain atlasida amigdalaning laterobazal (LB), sentromedial (CM) va yuzaki (SF) yadrolar guruhlari qanday vazifalarni bajaradi?

options.en: LB integrates sensory/prefrontal threat cues; CM drives hypothalamic/brainstem fear output; SF processes olfactory and social signals
options.uz: LB sezgi va prefrontal xavfni o'rganadi; CM gipotalamus/ustun qo'rquv chiqishini beradi; SF hid va ijtimoiy signallarni ishlaydi

options.en: LB drives hypothalamic autonomic fear output; CM integrates multimodal cortical threat cues; SF relays episodic memory to the fornix
options.uz: LB gipotalamus/ustun qo'rquv chiqishini beradi; CM sezgi va prefrontal xavfni o'rganadi; SF epizodik xotirani fornixga uzatadi

options.en: LB relays olfactory bulb input to entorhinal cortex; CM projects to visual cortex V1; SF drives hypothalamic sympathetic arousal
options.uz: LB hidlov signalini entorinal po'stloqqa uzatadi; CM ko'rish po'stlog'iga chiqish beradi; SF gipotalamik simpatik javobni boshqaradi

options.en: LB mediates vestibular balance reflexes; CM relays auditory input from MGN; SF projects exclusively to the mammillary bodies via fornix
options.uz: LB faqat vestibulyar signallarni qayta ishlaydi; CM MGN dan eshitish kirishini oladi; SF fornix orqali so'rg'ichsimon tanalarga boradi

why.en: In the amygdala (and Julich-Brain mapping), the cortex-like laterobasal group (LB) receives polymodal sensory and prefrontal inputs for Pavlovian fear conditioning; the striatum/pallidum-like centromedial group (CM) projects via the stria terminalis and ventral amygdalofugal pathway to the BNST, hypothalamus, and brainstem to trigger freezing, autonomic arousal, and CRH release; the superficial group (SF) is linked to the olfactory system.
why.uz: Amigdalaning laterobazal guruhi (LB, po'stloqqa o'xshash) sezgi va prefrontal kirishlarni olib xavf belgilarini o'rganadi; sentromedial guruhi (CM) stria terminalis va ventral amigdalofugal yo'l orqali gipotalamus hamda miya ustuniga chiqish berib vegetativ va stress javobini qo'zg'atadi; yuzaki guruhi (SF) hid va ijtimoiy signallarni qayta ishlaydi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005, Anat Embryol — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the human amygdala, hippocampal region and entorhinal cortex: intersubject variability and probability maps

q.en: How does the functional role of the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis (BNST, 'extended amygdala') differ from that of the central amygdala, and where is the BNST located?
q.uz: Stria terminalis to'shak yadrosining (BNST — 'kengaytirilgan amigdala') vazifasi amigdalaning o'zidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi va BNST qayerda joylashgan?

options.en: Wraps the anterior commissure and fornix columns (plate B2); mediates sustained anxiety and CRH stress output
options.uz: Oldingi komissura va fornix ustunlarini o'raydi (B2 plastinkasi); davomli xavotir va KRG stress javobini boshqaradi

options.en: Lies behind the pulvinar along the pineal stalk; mediates acute startle reflexes and circadian melatonin release
options.uz: Pulvinar ortida epifiz poyasi bo'ylab yotadi; o'tkir cho'chish refleksi va sirkadian melatonin ajralishini boshqaradi

options.en: Sits along the lateral wall of the temporal horn; mediates episodic memory consolidation and spatial place coding
options.uz: Chakka shoxining yon devori bo'ylab yotadi; epizodik xotirani mustahkamlash va fazoviy mo'ljal olishni ta'minlaydi

options.en: Lies within the internal medullary lamina of the thalamus; mediates somatosensory gating and pain localization
options.uz: Talamusning ichki medullyar plastinkasida yotadi; somatosensor filtratsiya va og'riq lokalizatsiyasini boshqaradi

why.en: The BNST is an extended-amygdala nucleus capping the anterior commissure and fornix columns (plate B2). Receiving the stria terminalis along the caudothalamic groove from the amygdala, it drives hypothalamic CRH and autonomic output to mediate sustained, unpredictable-threat anxiety (whereas the amygdala mediates acute phasic fear).
why.uz: BNST (stria terminalis to'shak yadrosi) oldingi komissura va fornix ustunlarini o'rab turadi (B2 plastinkasi). U amigdaladan stria terminalis orqali signal olib, gipotalamik stress (KRG) va vegetativ chiqishni boshqaradi hamda davomli xavotirni ta'minlaydi.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience — The importance of the amygdala (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: In contrast to the medial Papez circuit (hippocampus → fornix → mammillary body → anterior thalamus → cingulate), which structures form the parallel basolateral limbic (Yakovlev) circuit most closely tied to emotion and social valuation?
q.uz: Epizodik xotiraga xizmat qiluvchi medial Papez halqasidan farqli ravishda, hissiyot va ijtimoiy baholash uchun javobgar parallel bazolateral limbik (Yakovlev) halqasini qaysi tuzilmalar hosil qiladi?

options.en: Amygdala, orbitofrontal/anterior temporal cortex, and mediodorsal (MD) thalamus
options.uz: Amigdala, orbitofrontal/oldingi chakka po'stloq va mediodorsal (MD) talamus

options.en: Hippocampus, posterior cingulate cortex, and anterior nuclear group of the thalamus
options.uz: Gippokamp, orqa belbog' po'stlog'i va talamusning oldingi yadrolar guruhi

options.en: Dentate gyrus, globus pallidus internus, and ventral posterolateral (VPL) thalamus
options.uz: Tishsimon pushta, ichki rangpar shar (GPi) va ventral posterolateral (VPL) talamus

options.en: Septal nuclei, retrosplenial cortex, and pulvinar nuclear complex of the thalamus
options.uz: Septal yadrolar, retrosplenial po'stloq va talamusning pulvinar yadrolar majmuasi

why.en: While the Papez circuit (via the anterior thalamic nuclei) primarily serves episodic memory consolidation, emotional and reward valuation depend heavily on the parallel basolateral (Yakovlev) circuit linking the amygdala, mediodorsal (MD) thalamus, and orbitofrontal/anterior temporal cortex via the ventral amygdalofugal pathway and uncinate fasciculus.
why.uz: Papez halqasi (oldingi talamus yadrolari orqali) avvalo epizodik xotira uchun xizmat qilsa, hissiyot va mukofotni baholash uchun parallel bazolateral (Yakovlev) halqasi — amigdala, orbitofrontal po'stloq va talamusning mediodorsal (MD) yadrosi (ventral amigdalofugal yo'l va ilmoqsimon tutam orqali) muhimroqdir.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience — The importance of the amygdala (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: How do the anterior and posterior parts of the cingulate gyrus differ in function and clinical syndromes?
q.uz: Belbog' pushtasining (gyrus cinguli) oldingi va orqa qismlari vazifasi hamda zararlanish belgilari bo'yicha qanday farq qiladi?

options.en: Anterior regulates emotion, motivation, and affective pain (bilateral lesions cause akinetic mutism); posterior supports default-mode memory retrieval
options.uz: Oldingi qismi hissiyot, motivatsiya va og'riqning affektiv tomonini (zararlanishi — akinetik mutizm); orqa qismi default-mode xotirani chaqirishni boshqaradi

options.en: Anterior supports spatial navigation and default-mode memory retrieval; posterior regulates autonomic tone, affective pain, and error monitoring
options.uz: Oldingi qismi fazoviy mo'ljal va default-mode xotirani chaqirishni; orqa qismi vegetativ tonus, og'riqning affektiv tomoni va xato nazoratini boshqaradi

options.en: Anterior mediates conscious olfactory discrimination and gustation; posterior mediates visual object recognition and prosopagnosia prevention
options.uz: Oldingi qismi ongli hid va ta'm ajratishni boshqaradi; orqa qismi esa vizual obyektlarni tanish va yuzlarni ajratish funksiyasini ta'minlaydi

options.en: Anterior generates voluntary horizontal saccades and eye-head coordination; posterior processes primary somatosensory touch from the lower limb
options.uz: Oldingi qismi ixtiyoriy gorizontal sakkadalar va ko'z-bosh koordinatsiyasini; orqa qismi oyoqning birlamchi somatosensor teginish sezgisini qayta ishlaydi

why.en: The anterior cingulate cortex (ACC: subgenual sACC, pregenual pACC, dorsal midcingulate) integrates emotion, motivation, error monitoring, and the affective dimension of pain (bilateral ACA damage causes akinetic mutism; dorsal cingulotomy treats intractable pain and OCD). The posterior cingulate and retrosplenial cortex connect with the anterior thalamus and hippocampus in the Papez circuit and default-mode network.
why.uz: Belbog' pushtasining oldingi qismi emotsiya, motivatsiya, og'riqning yoqimsiz (affektiv) tomoni va vegetativ boshqaruvga javobgar (ikki tomonlama zararlanishi akinetik mutizm beradi; og'riq va OKBda singulotomiya nishoni). Orqa va retrosplenial qismi esa Papez halqasi hamda default-mode tarmog'ida xotirani chaqirishga xizmat qiladi.

sources.title: Palomero-Gallagher et al. 2008, J Comp Neurol — Cytology and receptor architecture of human anterior cingulate cortex

q.en: Which Nobel Prize–winning (2014) spatial navigation neuron types reside in the hippocampus proper (O'Keefe) and in the medial entorhinal cortex (Edvard and May-Britt Moser)?
q.uz: Fazoviy mo'ljal olishni ta'minlovchi (2014 yil Nobel mukofoti) qaysi maxsus neyron turlari gippokampning o'zida (O'Keefe) va medial entorinal po'stloqda (Moserlar) joylashgan?

options.en: Place cells in the hippocampus (CA1/CA3) and hexagonal grid cells in the medial entorhinal cortex
options.uz: Gippokampda (CA1/CA3) joy hujayralari (place cells) va entorinal po'stloqda to'r hujayralari (grid cells)

options.en: Hexagonal grid cells in the hippocampus (CA1/CA3) and head-direction cells in the entorhinal cortex
options.uz: Gippokampda (CA1/CA3) olti burchakli to'r hujayralari va entorinal po'stloqda bosh-yo'nalish hujayralari

options.en: Mirror neurons in the hippocampal subiculum and spindle (von Economo) neurons in the entorhinal cortex
options.uz: Gippokamp subikulumida oyna neyronlari va entorinal po'stloqda urchuqsimon (von Economo) neyronlari

options.en: Medium spiny D1/D2 neurons in the hippocampus and magnocellular oxytocin neurons in the entorhinal cortex
options.uz: Gippokampda D1/D2 o'rta tikanli neyronlar va entorinal po'stloqda magnotsellyulyar oksitotsin neyronlari

why.en: Hippocampal pyramidal neurons (CA1/CA3) fire when an individual is at a specific location ('place cells', John O'Keefe), while neurons in the medial entorhinal cortex fire on a periodic triangular/hexagonal coordinate lattice across the environment ('grid cells', May-Britt and Edvard Moser), complemented by head-direction cells in the anterior thalamus and postsubiculum.
why.uz: Gippokampning (CA1/CA3) piramidal neyronlari muayyan joyda faollashuvchi 'joy hujayralari'ni (place cells — O'Keefe), entorinal po'stloq neyronlari esa fazoviy koordinata panjarasini tuzuvchi 'to'r hujayralari'ni (grid cells — Moserlar) hosil qiladi; ularni oldingi talamus va postsubikulumdagi bosh-yo'nalish hujayralari to'ldiradi.

q.en: In 1953, patient H.M. (Henry Molaison) underwent bilateral medial temporal lobe resection for intractable epilepsy (Scoville & Milner 1957). Which memory profile resulted from the bilateral removal of his hippocampi, amygdalae, and parahippocampal cortices?
q.uz: 1953 yilda bemor H.M.da og'ir epilepsiya sababli ikki tomonlama medial chakka bo'lagi rezeksiyasi (gippokamp, amigdala va parahippokampal po'stloq) bajarildi (Scoville va Milner 1957). Operatsiyadan keyin bemorda xotiraning qanday buzilishi kuzatildi?

options.en: Profound anterograde amnesia for new declarative memories, with intact procedural motor learning and working memory
options.uz: Yangi deklarativ xotiralar uchun og'ir anterograd amneziya, ammo protsedural harakat o'rganish va ishchi xotira saqlangan

options.en: Complete loss of procedural motor skills and spoken language, with fully preserved consolidation of new episodic memories
options.uz: Protsedural harakat ko'nikmalari va nutqning butunlay yo'qolishi, ammo yangi epizodik xotiralarni saqlash to'liq saqlangan

options.en: Isolated loss of remote childhood autobiographical memories, with normal encoding and recall of events after surgery
options.uz: Operatsiyadan keyingi voqealarni normal eslab qolgan holda faqat uzoq bolalik avtobiografik xotiralarining yo'qolishi

options.en: Severe deficit in digit-span working memory and striatal habit learning, with intact delayed recall of new facts
options.uz: Qisqa muddatli ishchi xotira va striatal odatlarni o'rganishning og'ir buzilishi, ammo yangi faktlarni eslab qolish normal

why.en: Scoville & Milner (1957) showed in patient H.M. that bilateral medial temporal resection abolishes consolidation of new declarative (episodic and semantic) memories into long-term storage (profound anterograde amnesia with temporally graded retrograde amnesia), while remote neocortical memories, digit-span working memory, general intelligence, and procedural motor learning (mirror-drawing) remain intact.
why.uz: Scoville va Milner (1957) bemor H.M. misolida ikki tomonlama medial chakka (gippokamp) olib tashlanganda yangi deklarativ/epizodik xotiralarni uzoq muddatli xotiraga o'tkazish butunlay yo'qolishini (og'ir anterograd amneziya), ammo eski mustahkamlangan xotiralar (neokorteks), ishchi xotira (prefrontal), umumiy intellekt va protsedural harakat o'rganish (ko'zguda rasm chizish — bazal yadrolar va miyacha) saqlanib qolishini isbotladilar.

sources.title: Scoville & Milner 1957, J Neurol Neurosurg Psychiatry — Loss of recent memory after bilateral hippocampal lesions

q.en: A 49-year-old malnourished man with chronic alcohol use disorder is brought to the emergency department with acute confusion, unsteady wide-based gait, and bilateral abducens palsies with nystagmus. After receiving intravenous dextrose without prior vitamin supplementation, he develops severe persistent anterograde amnesia and prominent confabulation. On coronal MRI at the mammillary level (plate G3), which Papez-circuit and diencephalic structures show symmetric T2/FLAIR hyperintensity and petechial haemorrhage?
q.uz: Surunkali alkogolizm va ovqatlanish tanqisligi bo'lgan 49 yoshli bemor o'tkir ong chalkashishi, keng qadamli ataksiya hamda ikki tomonlama VI nerv falaji va nistagm bilan keltirildi. Vitamin bermasdan tomir ichiga glyukoza quyilgandan so'ng unda konfabulyatsiyalar bilan kechuvchi og'ir anterograd amneziya rivojlandi. Mamillyar darajadagi koronal MRTda (G3 plastinkasi) qaysi tuzilmalarda simmetrik T2/FLAIR signal o'zgarishi va nuqtali qon quyilishlar ko'rinadi?

options.en: Mammillary bodies, anterior/mediodorsal thalamus, and periaqueductal grey (Wernicke–Korsakoff syndrome)
options.uz: So'rg'ichsimon tanalar, oldingi/mediodorsal talamus va periakveduktal kulrang modda (Wernicke–Korsakoff)

options.en: Bilateral caudate heads, putamina, and external globus pallidus (Huntington striatal degeneration)
options.uz: Ikki tomonlama dumli yadro boshi, putamen va tashqi rangpar shar (Huntington striatal degeneratsiyasi)

options.en: Bilateral subthalamic nuclei, substantia nigra pars reticulata, and red nuclei (subthalamic infarct)
options.uz: Ikki tomonlama subtalamik yadrolar, qora modda to'rsimon qismi va qizil yadrolar (subtalamik infarkt)

options.en: Bilateral dentate nuclei, superior cerebellar peduncles, and central pontine tegmentum (osmotic myelinolysis)
options.uz: Ikki tomonlama tishsimon yadrolar, yuqori miyacha oyoqchalari va markaziy ko'prik (osmotik miyelinoliz)

why.en: Thiamine (vitamin B1) deficiency causes Wernicke encephalopathy (confusion, ophthalmoplegia, ataxia), which progresses to Korsakoff amnestic syndrome (anterograde amnesia + confabulation) due to symmetric hemorrhagic necrosis of the mammillary bodies, anterior/mediodorsal thalamus (Papez circuit nodes), and periaqueductal grey. Thiamine must always be administered before glucose.
why.uz: Tiamin (B1 vitamini) tanqisligi Wernicke ensefalopatiyasini (chalkashlik, oftalmoplegiya, ataksiya) va Papez halqasi tugunlari — so'rg'ichsimon tanalar hamda oldingi/mediodorsal talamus (va PAG) zararlanishi tufayli konfabulyatsiyali Korsakoff anterograd amneziyasini chaqiradi. Tiamin har doim glyukozadan oldin berilishi shart.

q.en: After herpes simplex virus encephalitis (or rare congenital Urbach–Wiethe disease) causing bilateral destruction of the anterior temporal poles and amygdalae, a patient exhibits emotional placidity (loss of fear), compulsive examination of non-food objects with the mouth, indiscriminate hypersexuality, and visual agnosia ('psychic blindness'). What is this syndrome?
q.uz: Gerpesvirusli ensefalit (yoki kam uchraydigan tug'ma Urbach–Wiethe kasalligi) oqibatida chakka bo'laklarining oldingi qutbi va ikkala amigdala zararlangach, bemorda qo'rquv hissining yo'qolishi (yuvoshlik), barcha narsalarni og'ziga solib ko'rish (giperoralizm), giperseksuallik va vizual agnoziya paydo bo'ldi. Bu qaysi sindrom?

options.en: Klüver–Bucy syndrome (bilateral amygdala and anterior temporal lesion)
options.uz: Klüver–Bucy sindromi (amigdala va oldingi chakka zararlanishi)

options.en: Gerstmann syndrome (dominant left angular gyrus parietal lesion)
options.uz: Gerstmann sindromi (dominant chap burchak pushtasi zararlanishi)

options.en: Dejerine–Roussy syndrome (posterolateral thalamic VPL/VPM infarction)
options.uz: Dejerine–Roussy sindromi (talamusning VPL/VPM yadrolari infarkti)

options.en: Balint syndrome (bilateral parieto-occipital watershed infarction)
options.uz: Balint sindromi (ikki tomonlama tepa-ensa chegara zonasi infarkti)

why.en: Bilateral ablation or destruction of the amygdala and adjacent anterior temporal cortex produces Klüver–Bucy syndrome: loss of fear and defensive aggression (placidity), hyperorality, hypermetamorphosis, hypersexuality, and visual agnosia.
why.uz: Amigdala (bodomsimon tana) va oldingi chakka po'stlog'ining ikki tomonlama zararlanishi Klüver–Bucy sindromini keltirib chiqaradi: qo'rquvni yo'qotish (yuvoshlik), giperoralizm (narsalarni og'izga olish), giperseksuallik va vizual agnoziya.

sources.title: Purves, Neuroscience — The importance of the amygdala (NCBI Bookshelf)

q.en: A 28-year-old woman with a history of prolonged febrile seizures in infancy has drug-resistant focal impaired-awareness seizures that begin with a rising epigastric sensation, déjà vu, and lip-smacking automatisms. High-resolution coronal T2/FLAIR MRI through the temporal horn shows volume loss, increased T2 signal, and flattening of the internal digitations (pes hippocampi) of the right hippocampal head. Which subfields show the most severe neuronal loss on surgical pathology of this condition (mesial temporal / hippocampal sclerosis)?
q.uz: Go'dakligida uzoq davom etgan febril tutqanoq o'tkazgan 28 yoshli ayolda epigastral sohadan ko'tariluvchi yoqimsiz his, déjà vu va lab chapillatish avtomatizmlari bilan kechuvchi dori-chidamli fokal epilepsiya mavjud. Koronal T2/FLAIR MRTda o'ng gippokamp boshining kichrayishi, T2 giperintensivligi va ichki 'barmoqchalari'ning (pes hippocampi) tekislanib ketgani aniqlandi. Ushbu holatda (mezial chakka / gippokampal skleroz) qaysi submaydonlarda neyronlar eng ko'p nobud bo'ladi?

options.en: CA1 (Sommer's sector) and CA4/hilus, with relative sparing of CA2
options.uz: CA1 (Sommer sektori) va CA4/hilus, CA2 nisbatan saqlangan holda

options.en: CA2 and subiculum exclusively, with complete sparing of CA1 and CA4
options.uz: Faqat CA2 va subikulum, CA1 va CA4 butunlay saqlangan holda

options.en: Mammillary body and anterior thalamus, with a spared hippocampus
options.uz: So'rg'ichsimon tana va oldingi talamus, gippokamp saqlangan holda

options.en: Caudate tail and stria terminalis in the roof of the temporal horn
options.uz: Chakka shoxi tomidagi kaudat dumi va stria terminalis sohalari

why.en: Mesial temporal lobe epilepsy is classically driven by hippocampal sclerosis, which on MRI shows hippocampal atrophy, T2/FLAIR hyperintensity, and loss of the pes hippocampi digitations, and histologically features severe pyramidal cell loss in CA1 (Sommer's sector) and CA4/CA3 with classic relative sparing of CA2.
why.uz: Mezial chakka epilepsiyasining klassik asosi — gippokampal sklerozda MRTda gippokamp kichrayishi, T2/FLAIR signal kuchayishi va boshidagi 'barmoqchalar' (pes hippocampi) yo'qolishi ko'rinadi; gistologik jihatdan esa CA1 (Sommer sektori) va CA4/CA3 neyronlari eng ko'p nobud bo'ladi (CA2 nisbatan saqlanadi).

q.en: A patient undergoes transcallosal transforaminal resection of a large third-ventricular craniopharyngioma at the interventricular foramina of Monro (plates B2/B5). Postoperatively, the patient is alert, fluent, and has normal motor and sensory exams, but cannot remember any conversation or visitors from 5 minutes earlier. Postoperative MRI shows bilateral interruption of the columns of a white-matter tract arching at the anterior margin of the foramina of Monro. Which structure was injured, and what is the clinical target of deep-brain stimulation of this same circuit in refractory epilepsy (SANTE trial) versus early Alzheimer disease (ADvance trial)?
q.uz: Monro teshiklari sohasidagi (B2/B5 plastinkalari) yirik III qorincha o'smasini olib tashlash operatsiyasidan so'ng bemorning hushi, nutqi hamda harakat va sezgi tekshiruvi to'liq normal, biroq u 5 daqiqa oldin bo'lgan suhbatni umuman eslay olmaydi. Operatsiyadan keyingi MRTda Monro teshiklarining oldingi chetida joylashgan juft oq modda ustunlarining ikki tomonlama uzilgani aniqlandi. Qaysi tuzilma shikastlangan va ushbu Papez halqasining qaysi tugunlari dori-chidamli epilepsiyada (SANTE) hamda erta Altsgeymerda (ADvance) DBS nishoni sifatida qo'llaniladi?

options.en: Columns of the fornix; anterior thalamic nucleus DBS for epilepsy (SANTE) and fornix DBS for Alzheimer disease (ADvance)
options.uz: Fornix ustunlari; epilepsiyada talamus oldingi yadrosi DBS'i (SANTE) va Altsgeymerda fornix DBS'i (ADvance)

options.en: Anterior commissure fibres; mediodorsal thalamus DBS for epilepsy (SANTE) and amygdala DBS for Alzheimer disease (ADvance)
options.uz: Oldingi komissura tolalari; epilepsiyada mediodorsal talamus DBS'i (SANTE) va Altsgeymerda amigdala DBS'i (ADvance)

options.en: Internal capsule genu; ventral posterolateral thalamus DBS for epilepsy (SANTE) and STN DBS for Alzheimer disease (ADvance)
options.uz: Ichki kapsula tizzasi; epilepsiyada VPL talamus DBS'i (SANTE) va Altsgeymerda subtalamik yadro DBS'i (ADvance)

options.en: Stria medullaris thalami; habenular complex DBS for epilepsy (SANTE) and mammillary body DBS for Alzheimer disease (ADvance)
options.uz: Stria medullaris thalami; epilepsiyada habenula majmuasi DBS'i (SANTE) va Altsgeymerda mamillyar DBS'i (ADvance)

why.en: The columns of the fornix form the anterior border of the foramina of Monro (plates B2/B5); bilateral surgical injury interrupts hippocampal outflow to the mammillary bodies and causes profound anterograde amnesia. Within the same Papez circuit, the anterior thalamic nuclear group is the FDA-approved DBS target for refractory focal epilepsy (SANTE trial), while fornix DBS was tested in the ADvance trial for early Alzheimer disease.
why.uz: Fornix ustunlari Monro teshiklarining bevosita oldingi chegarasini hosil qiladi (B2/B5 plastinkalari); ularning ikki tomonlama shikastlanishi Papez halqasini uzib, og'ir anterograd amneziya beradi. Shu halqada talamusning oldingi yadrolar guruhi dori-chidamli epilepsiyada (SANTE sinovi), fornix esa erta Altsgeymerda (ADvance sinovi) DBS nishoni hisoblanadi.
